summary: The board is at the very beginning relative to the goal of a single-axis FOC servo drive with EtherCAT. Only U1 (MPFS025TC-FCSG325 PolarFire SoC) is placed; there are zero nets, all 325 pins are unconnected, the only net class is Default, and both inner plane layers in the 8-layer stack have no plane_net assigned. None of the mandatory subsystems exist yet: power tree, decoupling, DDR memory, boot/config flash, reference clock, the motor power stage (gate driver + MOSFETs + current sense), encoder interface, programming header, or the EtherCAT PHYs. A true power budget cannot be computed because U1.electrical.power_domains is null (the PPAT carries pin function but not per-rail current), so regulator sizing below is provisional and must be confirmed against the PolarFire SoC Datasheet DC characteristics and the SoC Power Estimator. Recommended next step: bring up the FPGA-SoC core (power, decap, DDR, boot, clock, JTAG, planes) first, then add the motor-drive stage, then the EtherCAT port.

actions.value: assign GND to stackup layer 1 and a power plane to layer 6; both plane_net are currently null
actions.reason: Routing, return paths and decoupling all need solid reference planes. With unassigned planes the SI/PI engines and DRC cannot evaluate the board. At 0.5 mm BGA pitch + DDR4 the 8-layer count is workable but tight; re-evaluate to 10 if DDR escape + reference integrity fails.

actions.value: 1.0V (or 1.05V perf) core buck, size to measured core current
actions.reason: U1 core supply (VDD, ~14 balls) has no source. Highest-current rail; provisional until power_domains/DC characteristics give the real load.

actions.value: 1.8V and 2.5V rails (one per rail) for VDD18 / VDD25 / VDDAUX / bank VDDIx
actions.reason: VDD18, VDD25, VDDAUXx and per-bank VDDIx supplies are all unsourced. Per PPAT note, every used bank's VDDI/VDDAUX must be powered even if I/O is unused.

actions.value: low-noise LDO from VDD_CORE + ferrite for VDDA / VDD_XCVR_CLK
actions.reason: VDDA and the transceiver/clock analog rails need a quiet supply for PLL/SerDes jitter; a filtered LDO off the core rail is standard practice.

actions.value: 100nF 0402 X7R, one per power ball cluster (~40-60 pcs) + 4.7/10uF bulk per rail
actions.reason: U1.electrical.required_externals and BGA practice: every VDD/VDDA/VDDI ball group needs local decoupling. None present. Binding requirement before power-up.
MSS_DDR interface (53 balls) is present and a Linux-class FOC controller needs external DRAM; none placed. Requires a length-matched, 80-90 ohm-class net class.
PolarFire SoC boots from external SPI/QSPI flash; no boot device present. Connects to the dedicated SPI (SCK/SS/SDI/SDO) pins.

actions.value: low-jitter reference oscillator (freq per MSS/XCVR plan)
actions.reason: MSS_REFCLK and XCVR REFCLK diff pairs exist in the high_speed list but have no source. SerDes/Ethernet need a clean reference clock.

actions.value: 3-phase smart gate driver with 3 integrated current-sense amplifiers
actions.reason: Core of the FOC stage and entirely missing. Takes 6 PWM/INHx-INLx from FPGA fabric, drives the 6 MOSFETs, and provides the 3 phase-current sense channels FOC needs. Integrated CSAs save parts and improve match.

actions.value: 6x power MOSFET (3 half-bridges); reselect Vds/Rds(on) for the actual DC-bus voltage and phase current
actions.reason: Three-phase inverter bridge for the motor; none present. Example OptiMOS part — final choice depends on bus voltage/current, which set the whole power stage.
Position feedback (quadrature / BiSS / EnDat) needs differential receivers into the FPGA fabric; encoder interface is missing. Choose per encoder protocol.

actions.value: 2x 10/100 Ethernet PHY (MII) + magnetics + dual RJ45 for EtherCAT IN/OUT
actions.reason: Stretch-goal EtherCAT: needs two PHYs feeding an EtherCAT Slave Controller implemented in fabric. Note ESC IP licensing (Beckhoff/Microchip) is a separate requirement.
TMS/TCK/TDI/TDO/TRSTB are unconnected; a programming/debug header is required to load the device.

risks: Power budget is unverifiable: U1.electrical.power_domains is null. Pull the PolarFire SoC Datasheet DC characteristics and run the SoC Power Estimator before finalizing regulators; size MPM3833C/MPM3610 to real currents.
Power-up sequencing: PolarFire SoC has rail sequencing requirements (see Power-Up and Resets User Guide). A simple independent-regulator scheme may need enable sequencing or a sequencer/PMIC.
HDI/manufacturability: 0.5 mm BGA needs via-in-pad/microvias; with DDR4 + reference planes the 8-layer stack may need to grow to 10. Confirm with your fab's HDI rules.
Plane nets unassigned — assign GND/power planes before any routing or SI/PI analysis.

Motor power stage is high-voltage/high-current: partition power ground from logic ground (single-point tie), respect creepage/clearance, plan gate-loop and shunt-sense layout, and add DC-bus bulk capacitance and a TVS/clamp.
FOC timing: ADC current sampling must be synchronized to PWM; plan the sense path and trigger in fabric.
EtherCAT requires licensed ESC IP and careful PHY/MII timing; treat as a separate milestone after core bring-up.
